behavior: before_agent_start handlers run in extension order and later handlers see earlier system-prompt changes.
The event contains the submitted prompt, image attachments, and current system prompt; a handler may replace the system prompt or add a custom message.
Handler errors are reported without stopping later handlers. Run preparation applies the prompt changes before appending the starting message.
ExtensionRegistration.AddBeforeAgentStartHandler registers ordered callbacks with source provenance and reload rollback/reselection support.

ConversationRun invokes the callbacks once before each submitted user turn is accepted or saved. Later handlers observe the latest complete system prompt, including additional MCP server instructions.
A returned system prompt replaces provider instructions for that turn. Additional MCP instructions are not appended twice, and the override is cleared after settlement.
Callbacks receive expanded prompt text, image attachments, live extension context, and cancellation. Exceptions emit extension_error and later callbacks continue.
limitations: Idle custom-message triggerTurn runs, handler-injected custom messages, and mutable system-prompt option sections are not implemented.
